en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to me by Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-’Attar from his father from Muhammad b. Ahmad from Musa b. Umar from Muhammad b. Sinan from Abi Sa’eed al-Qammat from Umar b. Yazid from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
Washing head with marsh- mallow (Khatmi) ends headache, diseases and poverty and protects head from dryness.”
